node.label: Scapular muscle atrophy
node.definition: Atrophy of the muscles that are responsible for moving the scapula, which are the levator scapulae, the infraspinatus muscle, the teres major, the teres minor, and the supraspinatus muscle.

diseases.label: autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2A

evidence.snippet: Calpain-3-related limb-girdle muscular dystrophy R1: Scapular muscle atrophy (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
